observation_summary: The JSDoc parser was stripping leading whitespace from lines in comments marked with @preserve or @license, causing ASCII art or formatted text to lose its intended indentation.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves modifying the internal logic of the JSDoc parsing loop to track the start of lines and explicitly append the correct number of spaces when whitespace preservation is enabled. This is a procedural change to the comment extraction algorithm, not a simple value assignment or a missing guard condition.
evidence_used: The fix adds 'lineStartChar' tracking to calculate the number of spaces to preserve.
The fix modifies the loop logic to append spaces based on the calculated 'numSpaces' instead of just appending a single space.
The bug report states that ASCII art loses its indentation, which is a failure of the text processing algorithm.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix introduces new variables (lineStartChar), the core of the fix is the procedural logic that calculates and appends the whitespace, which is an algorithmic correction.
The fix adds conditional logic (if/else), but these are not guards or validation checks; they are part of the core processing logic for formatting the output string.
